notes.title: Version 1.7.1
notes.content:
New Update: What's added?
- Added check point closer to the fan.
- Added a giant shark boss and a new type of gameplay.
- Added Game end reward: Golden Cat Skin.
- Added achievement rewards.
- Added mouse speed adjustment system.
- Add next button.



New Update: What's fixed?
- Fixed the game levels to be easier to play.
Climb.
- Fixed cat nip's game system, switching height and distance bars.
- Fixed the achievement system to be usable.
- Fixed bug at the end of the game.
- Edit songs, change new songs.
- Edit and adjust language.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v1iHB3HPc38

notes.title: Halloween and Catnip
notes.content:
It's almost Halloween, so there's an update on Halloween props that doesn't affect the gameplay.
Add more updates in the game, such as adjusting graphics, snowing effects, turning on and off the music.

Added obstacles in the game is catnip.
catnip is a plant that numbs cats. This makes jumping more difficult to move around and more difficult to maneuver.

The game will be updated in each festival for sure.
